extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to demonstrate the in-scope issue by searching for any selected rate that pairs a complete-domain claim with the 72-station retained-subset denominator. The selected result (results/report.md L15) instead divides 18 by all 96 scheduled stations, matching the stated target population (L4: all 96 scheduled stations) and the task. I verified against inputs/data.csv that there are 96 scheduled data rows and 18 rows with occurrence_flag=1, and that 18/96 = 0.1875 as reported. Treating the 24 NA stations as zero occurrences is a distinct methodological choice, but it is explicitly disclosed as a lower bound (L18) and is not the declared retained-subset-denominator issue class.
